content_of_post_to_answer: What is one oral health habit you wish you had started earlier?
answer: I wish I had learned earlier that oral health is less about the occasional big effort and more about protecting small daily systems. I used to think brushing was the habit, but the real habit is noticing what happens between dental visits: plaque buildup, gum changes, sensitivity, and small warning signs. Teeth often don't hurt until problems are advanced, so consistency matters more than intensity. The mouth is one of the few parts of the body where prevention is usually far easier than repair.
